title: Recent advances of silver nanoparticle-based polymer nanocomposites for biomedical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8480-8505
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08220F, Review Article

Mohammad Harun-Ur-Rashid, Tahmina Foyez, Suresh Babu Naidu Krishna, Sudhakar Poda, Abu Bin Imran
Silver nanoparticle (AgNP)-polymer nanocomposites offer enhanced antimicrobial properties for biomedical applications, including medical devices and implants. Stability and biocompatibility remain key challenges to apply AgNPs in biomedical fields.
